_help.colleges: College names exactly as Sleeper spells them (case-insensitive).
_help.includeNames: Players to add even if their listed college is different, e.g. someone who played at this school then transferred out.
_help.excludeNames: Players to drop, e.g. a transfer-in you don't count.
_help.espnTeamId: ESPN's college-football team id (the number in the team's ESPN URL). Powers the Saturday tab.
